title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Automated MagAttract for Small Arthropods
author: Amy Denton

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer mastermix
steps.instruction: Prepare a lysis buffer mastermix with the following volumes per sample:

substeps.instruction: 100 µL Phosphate buffered saline (PBS)
10 µL Proteinase K
2 µL RNase A
75 µL Buffer AL

steps.title: Prepare samples for lysis
steps.instruction: Process samples based on their preparation method:

substeps.instruction: For cryogenically homogenised (cryoPREP) samples: Transfer 25 mg of sample into a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube on dry ice. Add 187 µL of lysis buffer mastermix and homogenise by gently pipetting 10 times with a wide-bore pipette tip.

For PowerMashed samples (< 25 mg): Transfer sample into a 1.5 mL BioMasher II tube and add 187 µL lysis buffer. Disrupt using the Diagnocine PowerMasher II tissue disruptor and BioMasher pestle until no large pieces remain. Transfer entire contents to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube using a wide-bore tip.

steps.title: Lysis and incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples to facilitate lysis:

substeps.instruction: Set a heat block to 25 °C.
Centrifuge sample tubes briefly in a mini-centrifuge.
Incubate at 25 °C for 3 hours.
Remove tubes from heat block and briefly centrifuge in a mini-centrifuge to spin down.

steps.title: Prepare KingFisher plates
steps.instruction: Label and fill seven 1 mL 96-well deep-well KingFisher™ plates and two 200 µL 96-well standard plates as follows:

substeps.instruction: Plate 1 (Tip Plate, 1 mL): 96-well tip comb (no reagent)
Plate 2 (Elution 2, 200 µL): 100 µL Buffer AE
Plate 3 (Elution 1, 200 µL): 100 µL Buffer AE
Plate 4 (NFW Wash, 1 mL): 350 µL Nuclease-free water
Plate 5 (PE Wash 2, 1 mL): 350 µL Buffer PE
Plate 6 (PE Wash 1, 1 mL): 350 µL Buffer PE
Plate 7 (MW1 Wash 2, 1 mL): 350 µL Buffer MW1
Plate 8 (MW1 Wash 1, 1 mL): 350 µL Buffer MW1
Plate 9 (Sample Plate, 1 mL): 15 µL Suspension G magnetic beads and 140 µL Buffer MB

steps.title: Load lysate and run extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer lysate and execute the automated extraction protocol:

substeps.instruction: Using a wide-bore pipette tip set to 200 µL, transfer lysate to the sample plate, avoiding large debris.
Select the DNA extraction protocol on the KingFisher™ Apex and press play.
Load filled plates as prompted by the screen.
Remove the Tip Plate when prompted before loading the Sample Plate.
Allow the protocol to run (approximately 66 minutes) and remove plates upon completion.

steps.title: Clean eluates and pool DNA
steps.instruction: Ensure eluates are bead-free and combine them for the next step:

substeps.instruction: Inspect elution plates for magnetic beads. If beads are present, transfer sample to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, place on a magnetic rack for 5 minutes, and collect clear eluate with a wide-bore tip.
Using a 200 µL multi-channel pipette and wide-bore tips, pipette eluates from Elution Plate 1 and Elution Plate 2 into a new 1 mL 96-well deep-well KingFisher™ plate.
Gently pipette mix 5–10 times with wide-bore tips to homogenise DNA.

steps.title: Prepare 0.45X SPRI plates
steps.instruction: Set up the plates for the 0.45X SPRI process:

substeps.instruction: Plate 1 (Tip Plate, 1 mL deep-well): 96-well tip comb (no reagent)
Plate 2 (Sample Plate, 1 mL deep-well): 180 µL DNA + 81 µL AMPure PB beads
Plate 3 (Ethanol Wash Plate, 1 mL deep-well): 1000 µL 80% EtOH (freshly prepared)
Plate 4 (Elution Plate, 200 µL standard): 135 µL Buffer EB

steps.title: Run 0.45X SPRI protocol
steps.instruction: Execute the SPRI cleanup on the KingFisher™ Apex:

substeps.instruction: Select the 0.45X SPRI protocol and press play.
Load filled plates following on-screen instructions.
Allow the protocol to run (approximately 40 minutes) and remove plates upon completion.

steps.title: Final recovery and storage
steps.instruction: Recover the purified DNA and store:

substeps.instruction: Using a wide-bore pipette tip, transfer 130 µL of eluate from the elution plate into microcentrifuge tubes.
Incubate DNA at room temperature overnight.
Perform QC the following morning.
Store DNA at 4 °C.
